title: Acceptance Verification Workset (Verification node output)
description: Wave 9 package-local schema (W9-A3) for the output of the verify-acceptance-workset development node. Trusted evidence for every accepted AC bound to the exact frozen candidate hash. Every record pins BOTH the AC acceptedHash AND the candidateHash. Outcomes unknown and error are denials that never authorize a verified bundle (invariants development.evidence-pins-candidate, development.unknown-denies).

acceptanceBaselineHash.description: sha256Hex of the accepted AC baseline the workset verifies against.

candidateHash.description: Exact frozen integrated-release-candidate hash. Evidence for any other value is inadmissible.

complete.description: True only when every accepted AC has trusted evidence bound to the unchanged candidate.

verificationHash.description: sha256Hex over the workset (all fields except verificationHash itself).

acceptedCriterionHash.description: sha256Hex of the accepted AC revision being verified.

candidateHash.description: Must equal the workset candidateHash exactly.

outcome.description: 4-valued CGAD verdict. unknown and error are denials.
